[DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Mon 19:17): Studentenproteste | Video-Überwachung | Stadt in Angst
item.description:
Originally published Mon 26 Oct 2026 19:17 IST.
In ganz Europa protestieren junge Menschen für eine bessere Zukunft. Auch in Deutschland sollen am Samstag bundesweit Demos stattfinden. Was halten Studierende in Berlin davon? Weitere Themen: Pläne für Videoüberwachung in Brandenburg, Tatverdächtiger nach Bluttat in Ortrand aus U-Haft entlassen. Und: Deutsch-polnische Gesundheitskooperation vor dem Aus?   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Tue 02:01): What's next for China after Xi Jinping?
item.description:
Originally published Tue 27 Oct 2026 02:01 IST.

This week the Chinese President Xi Jinping and his inner circle are meeting in Beijing for a series of closed-door meetings, known as plenums. Once those meetings have concluded, we're expecting to learn more about the senior figures that could shape the look of China's ruling Communist Party in the years to come. In this bonus episode we answer your questions about the next generation of Chinese leaders and how they might run the world superpower. Presenter Celia Hatton is joined by the BBC's China correspondent Stephen McDonell in Beijing and Shawn Yuan from the BBC Global China Unit and other Chinese expert guests.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world.
